plan: The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid your private value for the prize, which maximizes expected profit in the long run. Since my private value is $39 for this round, I will bid exactly $39. This approach ensures that if I win, my profit is maximized, as I pay the second-highest bid and gain the full value of the prize. Given there is only one round, this strategy is optimal.

The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid your private value, as it maximizes expected profit. Since my value for the prize is $34, I will bid $34. This approach ensures that I either win the prize at a cost less than or equal to my valuation or avoid overpaying. As this is the only round and there is no history to consider, I will follow this strategy to maximize potential profit.

The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid exactly my private value for the prize, which is $45. This strategy maximizes expected profit because if I win, I gain the difference between my value and the second-highest bid. Bidding higher risks overpaying, while bidding lower risks losing the auction when it would have been profitable to win. Given no history, I will adhere to the dominant strategy.
